name: claude-brain-kit
description: Your Claude, the same collaborator on every device — a git-backed personal brain. Plugins: brain (session sync, writes, skills) and brain-remote (remote brain MCP for clone-less sessions).

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Session-start auto-pull of your brain clone, a Stop-hook journal guard, concurrency-safe writes (brain-write.sh), zero-friction secrets + login keepalive, and the /brain:setup, /brain:todos, /brain:idea, write and profile skills.

plugins.name: brain-remote
plugins.description: Remote brain access for Claude Code sessions without a local clone — registers your self-hosted brain MCP server (tools/brain-remote). Needed only where no claude.ai connector reaches the session; if `claude mcp list` already shows `claude.ai brain-remote` (mirrored connector), skip it.
